name: statusline-pace
description: A pace band above the prompt: the model's plan windows (Claude 5h/7d or OpenCode Go 5h/7d/1mo), when they run out at the current burn, and an ETA to the reset.

showModel.title: Show the model
showModel.description: Show the model and effort (Opus high) at the start of the band.

showContext.title: Show context fill
showContext.description: Show the context window fill (ctx 34%) after the windows.

stateFile.title: Plan state file
stateFile.description: Path to a claude-litellm-router state.json for the OpenCode Go windows (plans.go) and the Claude fallback; ~ allowed. Empty = off.
